narrative.northStar: Crisp and understated — white, ink, restrained blue
narrative.overview:
White work surfaces and a cool navigation rail keep attention on amounts, dates, and record decisions. Ink typography, fine rules, and measured spacing establish hierarchy without surrounding every section with a card.

Cash, in-kind receipts, and checking spending remain visibly distinct. Unresolved states receive explicit labels and amber treatment; color supports the wording. This system is extracted from `src/ui/style.css` and `src/ui/main.tsx` after the November 12, 2026 finish review. The frontmatter records implemented values.
keyCharacteristics: White workspace, cool pale rail, and restrained blue actions.
One self-hosted sans family with aligned financial figures.
Open ruled groups, compact controls, and explicit state labels.
Responsive records that preserve meaning and readable metadata.

rules.name: The Meaning Before Color Rule
rules.body: Pair every financial series and decision color with a label; retain the cash versus in-kind distinction in nearby text.

rules.name: The Readable Metadata Rule
rules.body: At widths up to (700px), financial chart labels, decision badges, account lines, and amount explanations use at least (0.86rem), approximately (12px). Reflow the content instead of shrinking these labels.

rules.name: The Dialog Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary panels and controls flat; use the existing dialog shadow only for modal review and entry surfaces.

dos: Do use the implemented color roles and pair financial colors with explicit labels.
Do align amounts with tabular numerals and preserve cash, in-kind, and excluded-state wording.
Do reflow records and filters on mobile while keeping financial metadata at least approximately 12px.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, accessible control names, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use invented, clearly illustrative content in public design previews.
donts: Don't give ordinary analytical panels the dialog shadow or wrap every metric in a raised card.
Don't use color alone to imply a record's status or reporting inclusion.
Don't truncate the selected mobile filter label to preserve a compact header.
Don't treat synthesized sidecar tonal ramps as implemented application tokens.
